name: Publishing tool with a 'no AI-written words' content principle
user_idea: A standalone web tool that helps founders publish their thinking. The user records a voice memo or types a paragraph; the tool produces a single-page essay rendered from a fixed template. Every word on the page must be the founder's own — AI rearranges, never invents. The tool produces a public URL.

phase1.q1_relief_moment: The founder finishes their dump, sees the page, recognizes their own words on it, and posts the URL on Twitter — no editing, no second-guessing.
phase1.q2_yesterday: They opened a Google Doc, started typing, got stuck, closed it. Then opened ChatGPT, dumped their thoughts, got back generic AI prose, copied it to Twitter, and felt embarrassed.
phase1.q3_one_tiny_thing: Take a voice or text dump and produce a single-page essay rendered from a fixed template, populated entirely with the founder's own words, available at a unique URL.
phase1.q4_input_output: Input: a voice memo or typed paragraph. Output: a unique URL to a templated single-page essay using only the founder's words.
phase1.q5_the_line: No AI-written sentences anywhere on the page. No AI-generated images. No filler phrases AI adds to make it 'flow.' No auto-posting on the founder's behalf.

phase2.q2_shape: A tool that does the work
phase2.q2_followup_specific_shape: A wizard with named steps — Record / Review / Publish — with a Next button between each. Not a chat.
q4_brings_back: They have unfinished work in here
phase2.q5_hardest_moment: After their first win — they don't see why to come back
phase2.q7_visual_canon: A specific reference — Spotify Wrapped style HTML/CSS template, clean type, one essay per page

assertions.label: Constraints name the specific UI shape (wizard)
Anti-patterns name 'not a chat' in negative form
Phase plan branches on 'web/PWA' single-target (no native phasing)
